title: Projective Hom-complex model with its derived evaluation
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $P^\bullet$ a bounded-above cochain complex of projective $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module], and $N^\bullet$ any cochain complex of $R$-modules. Write $Q$ for localization at quasi-isomorphisms into $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $D^\bullet=\operatorname{Hom}_R^\bullet(P^\bullet,N^\bullet)$, the product total Hom complex of [def-sc-module-total-hom-complex], with $d(f)=d_Nf-(-1)^{|f|}fd_P$. Write $-\otimes_R^L-$ for the left derived total tensor product and $R\operatorname{Hom}_R$ for its right adjoint internal Hom. The canonical comparison
$$Q(D^\bullet)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\operatorname{Hom}_R(QP^\bullet,QN^\bullet)$$
is an isomorphism, natural contravariantly in $P^\bullet$ and covariantly in $N^\bullet$. The ordinary direct-sum total tensor complex $\operatorname{Tot}(P^\bullet\otimes_R D^\bullet)$ represents $QP^\bullet\otimes_R^LQ(D^\bullet)$. Under these comparisons the derived evaluation (the counit for $QP^\bullet\otimes_R^L-\dashv R\operatorname{Hom}_R(QP^\bullet,-)$) is represented by the chain map
$$x\otimes f\longmapsto(-1)^{pq}f(x)\in N^{p+q},\qquad x\in P^p,\quad f\in D^q.$$
Here total tensor has differential $d(x\otimes f)=d_Px\otimes f+(-1)^px\otimes d_Df$. No finite-generation assumption on $P^p$ and no boundedness assumption on $N^\bullet$ are imposed.
